description.value: Good Co. Northwoods is a full-service sports bar and restaurant at the eastern end of Dollarton Highway in North Vancouver, part of the Good Co. Bars multi-location chain. The venue blends a broad food menu — tacos, burgers, wings, salads — with a strong events calendar of trivia nights, watch parties, and dance evenings, plus a dedicated FIFA 2026 sports-viewing programme. OSM confirms wheelchair accessibility and a no-smoking policy throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Good Co. Northwoods at 2100 Dollarton Hwy, North Vancouver, matching the OSM address. The site shows an active menu, ongoing events, and a booking form listing the Northwoods location — the business is clearly open. The menu explicitly includes a gluten-free vegan bun option and several vegetarian/vegan items (Veggie Burger, Veggie Dumplings, Sofritas Tacos, Glory Bowl with tofu), confirming that amenity; no evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM name 'GoodCo' (no space, no period) differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Good Co.' and 'Good Co. Northwoods' — the OSM name may be a data-entry shorthand rather than the canonical trading name.
Phone number +1-604-770-4980 present in OSM but no phone number was visible in the scraped website text, so the number could not be cross-confirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active bar-restaurant with confirmed location and menu; a useful food and drink stop for cyclists on the Dollarton corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Burger (mushroom-rice patty), Veggie Dumplings, Sofritas Tacos, Glory Bowl with tofu, and explicitly offers a 'gluten free vegan bun' substitute; multiple salads are also vegetarian

wow_evidence: part of the Good Co. Bars multi-location chain
